output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, causing a potentially drastic reduction in the token's value.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if _value is large, causing the transfer function to become unusable.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if _value is large, causing the transfer function to become unusable.

output_list.vulnerability: The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowance mapping is incremented without a check, allowing the owner to set the allowance to a very high value.
The transferFrom function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It does not check if the target is frozen, allowing the owner to block users' assets.
